<function name="EquipAmmo" parent="WEAPON" type="hook">
	<description>
The player has picked up the weapon and has taken the ammo from it.
The weapon will be removed immediately after this call.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="ply" type="Player">The player who picked up the weapon</arg>
	</args>
</function>
